How to play

WASD / stick
Run. The view is fixed, so up runs into the screen.
Space / A
Jump. Ravel curls up in the air; land on Brassbacks to crack them.
Space again
Pounce at the nearest target, or air-dash if nothing is close.
Shift / X
Roll while running. Hold it standing still to coil, release to launch.
E / Y
Whistle. Scattered Glims nearby come back to you.
Esc / Start
Pause.

Free the five Glims in each area and lead them through the Moongate. Deliver more at once for a bigger wake bonus. Motes are your health: a hit spills up to 20 and scatters your Glims. Find Mossback with 50 motes for the root-run.

Controls
